entries.title: Exodus 17:1
segments: ¶And all the assembly of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, according to their journeys, at the command of Jehovah; and they encamped in Rephidim; and there was no water for the people to drink.

entries.title: Exodus 17:2
segments: And the people contended with Moses, and said, Give us water, that we may drink! And Moses said to them, Why do ye dispute with me? Why do ye tempt Jehovah?

entries.title: Exodus 17:3
segments: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Why is it that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

entries.title: Exodus 17:4
segments: And Moses cried to Jehovah, saying, What shall I do with this people? Yet a little, and they will stone me!

entries.title: Exodus 17:5
segments: And Jehovah said to Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel, and thy staff with which thou didst smite the river, take in thy hand, and go.

entries.title: Exodus 17:6
segments: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock on Horeb; and thou shalt strike the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so before the eyes of the elders of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 17:7
segments: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the contention of the children of Israel, and because they had tempted Jehovah, saying, Is Jehovah among us, or not?

entries.title: Exodus 17:8
segments: ¶And Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

entries.title: Exodus 17:9
segments: And Moses said to Joshua, Choose us men, and go out, fight with Amalek; to-morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the staff of God in my hand.

entries.title: Exodus 17:10
segments: And Joshua did as Moses had said to him, to fight with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

entries.title: Exodus 17:11
segments: And it came to pass when Moses raised his hand, that Israel prevailed; and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

entries.title: Exodus 17:12
segments: And Moses' hands were heavy; then they took a stone, and put [it] under him, and he sat on it; and Aaron and Hur supported his hands, one on this side, and one on that side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

entries.title: Exodus 17:13
segments: And Joshua broke the power of Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

entries.title: Exodus 17:14
segments: And Jehovah said to Moses, Write this [for] a memorial in the book, and rehearse [it] in the ears of Joshua, that I will utterly blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under the heavens.

entries.title: Exodus 17:15
segments: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi.

entries.title: Exodus 17:16
segments: And he said, For the hand is on the throne of Jah; Jehovah will have war with Amalek from generation to generation!
